summary: Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing termination of its ADS deposit agreement effective July 16, 2026, with a mandatory exchange of ADSs for underlying Class B ordinary shares. The company will hold an EGM on July 8, 2026, to vote on a 240-for-1 share consolidation, increasing par value from $0.00001 to $0.0024. After cancellation, ADS holders receive one Class B ordinary share per ADS, which will trade directly on Nasdaq under symbol TDTH. No price or premium stated. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and Nasdaq listing compliance post-exchange.
